expense_void: This expense is void: it takes no more payments or adjustments. Enter the right one as a new expense.
expense_payment_duplicate: A payment with this method and reference is already recorded on this expense. Check its payments.
expense_payment_exceeds_open: This payment is more than what's open on this expense.
expense_payment_already_reversed: This payment was already reversed. Check the payments.
expense_adjustment_exceeds_open: This reduction is more than what's open. To reduce more, reverse payments first.
expense_template_exists: A recurring expense with this name already exists (paused and ended ones count too). Use another name or rename the old one.
expense_template_starts_on_invalid: The first period must start at most a month before today and at most a year after.
expense_template_ends_on_invalid: The end can't be before the start or before the latest period already generated.
expense_category_in_use: An active recurring expense uses this category. Pause it or change its category first.
vendor_in_use: An active recurring expense uses this vendor. Pause it or change its vendor first.
pay_item_not_recurring: Only a recurring item has an end date. Delete it and add it again if needed.
pay_item_end_before_start: The end can't be before the start.
pay_item_end_before_paid_period: This item was already paid in a finalized period starting after that date. Choose a later date.
pay_item_in_use: A prepared or finalized period uses this item, so it can't be deleted. The period must be returned first, or end the item.
text_invalid: This text has an invalid character. Enter it again.
effective_to_not_allowed: Only a recurring item has an end date.
effective_to_before_from: The end can't be before the start.
payroll_amount_out_of_range: This period's lines or total are beyond the maximum amount. End or delete one of the tutor's bonuses, then recalculate.
payroll_period_not_open: This period isn't open any more.
payroll_period_not_ended: This period hasn't ended yet, so it can't be prepared.
payroll_unresolved_work: Some approved work has no pay basis, so this period can't go on. Fix it from the Unresolved work tab.
payroll_negative_total: This period's total is below zero, so it can't be prepared.
payroll_period_not_prepared: This period isn't prepared any more.
payroll_self_finalize: Someone else must finalize this period: you prepared it, or it's your own pay.
payroll_review_outdated: This period was prepared again after you opened it. Review it again.
payroll_period_out_of_order: An earlier period of this tutor must be finalized first.
payroll_period_stale: Something changed since this period was prepared. Send it back to Finance to prepare it again.
payroll_review_route_required: This period is decided on its own page.
effective_from_under_finalized_line: A finalized payroll line uses the current rate on this date. Choose a later date, and pay the difference with an adjustment.
payroll_no_period: This tutor has no payroll period yet. Add their pay terms and try again.
payroll_line_not_finalized: That line isn't in a finalized period any more. The page was reloaded.
payroll_work_not_unresolved: That work isn't unresolved any more: it has pay now, or it changed. The list was reloaded.
payroll_work_before_first_period: That work is from before the tutor's first period: pay it with a one-time item.
payroll_work_settled: An adjustment already pays that work. The list was reloaded.
payroll_total_not_negative: This period's total isn't below zero any more, so there's no balance to carry. The page was reloaded.
compensation_rate_delete_under_finalized: Without this version, a finalized payroll line would get another price, so it can't be deleted.
adjustment_references_both: An adjustment corrects a line or pays work, not both.
paid_on_in_future: The payment date can't be after today.
paid_on_before_period: The payment date can't be before the payroll period starts.
payroll_period_not_finalized: This period isn't finalized, so it can't take payments.
payroll_payment_duplicate: A payment with this method and reference is already recorded on this period. Check the list of payments.
payroll_payment_exceeds_balance: This payment is more than what is left to pay for this period.
payroll_payment_already_reversed: This payment was already reversed. Check the list of payments.
notification_type_unknown: That notification type isn't in your list. Reload the page.
notification_type_mandatory: That notification is required and can't be turned off.
notification_type_duplicate: A notification type appears twice in the change.
import_too_large: The file is too large (at most 2 MB).
import_file_invalid: The CSV file couldn't be read.
import_too_many_rows: The file has too many rows.
import_not_committable: This import can no longer be imported.
import_nothing_to_commit: No rows are ready to import.
import_not_discardable: This import can no longer be discarded.
export_range_invalid: The date range isn't valid: the end date can't be before the start date, and the range can't be longer than a year.
export_limit_reached: You already have 3 exports in progress. Wait for one to finish.
export_not_ready: This export doesn't have a file yet.
export_expired: This export has expired. Request it again.
report_setup_limit_reached: You already have 50 saved setups; delete one first.
report_setup_name_taken: You already have a setup with this name.
dashboard_widget_unavailable: One of the widgets is no longer available to you.
job_not_retryable: This job's task can't be retried.
job_not_failed: This job is no longer failed.
job_already_queued: A queued run will already cover this job.
